name: LeetCodeDataset
description: LeetCodeDataset is a high-quality benchmark for evaluating and training code-generation models, focusing on reasoning-intensive Python problems with rich metadata and extensive test cases. It features temporal splits to enable contamination-free evaluation and efficient supervised fine-tuning.
reputation: A promising newer code benchmark for contamination-aware evaluation, but not yet as widely established as long-running coding benchmarks like HumanEval or MBPP.
notes: Includes temporal splits (pre/post July 2024) and over 100 test cases per problem.
